title: CarbonLEI extension 0.1.0: the data object
description: Schema of the `data` object of the CarbonLEI element in `extensions` of a PACT v3 ProductFootprint, as written by `exportPact` in sdk/pact.ts. Field meanings: https://github.com/zuemen/carbon-lei/blob/main/docs/PACT_MAPPING.md. All values are illustrative; this is not official CBAM methodology.

cbam.description: CBAM fields of the credential that the supplier disclosed in the proof. Hidden fields are never present. Values are strings, as in the credential.

boundary.description: Fixed: the value covers CBAM direct embedded emissions only, not a full product carbon footprint.

installationId.description: Installation ID in the demo normal form: country code, operator LEI, four-digit sequence. Checked by the verifier before any export.

cnCode.description: CN code: 4, 6 or 8 digits, no spaces. Checked by the verifier before any export.

cbamRoute.description: Production route code: one upper-case letter. Checked by the verifier before any export.

verifiedTonnes.description: Verified quantity in tonnes, a decimal string.

valueType.description: Value type of the emissions figure, as written in the credential.

accreditationNumber.description: Accreditation number of the verification body.

nabName.description: Name of the national accreditation body.

siteVisit.description: Site visit, as written in the credential.

assuranceLevel.description: Assurance level, as written in the credential.

materialityThreshold.description: Materiality threshold, as written in the credential.

carbonlei.description: Where to re-check the credential: its ID, its signers and its on-chain record.

credSAID.description: Self-addressing identifier (SAID) of the credential: 44 base64url characters.

verifierLEI.description: LEI of the verification body, from the issuer block of the signed credential.

auditorAID.description: The lead auditor's KERI identifier (AID), from the issuer block of the signed credential.

kelSeq.description: Sequence number of the auditor's KEL event that anchors the credential, read from the on-chain report, as a decimal string.

reportKey.description: Report key in the registry: keccak256 of the credential SAID, lower-case hex.
